decisive_items: Positive nasopharyngeal swab RT-PCR for SARS-CoV-2
response.rationale: The combination of SARS-CoV-2 infection and optic neuritis symptoms makes R5 the most likely diagnosis, with R1 being a close runner-up due to the presence of optic neuritis symptoms, but R5 has the added specificity of the SARS-CoV-2 infection

rejected.why: While retinal vasculitis is present, it is not the primary diagnosis, but rather a symptom of the underlying condition
Uveitis is also present, but it is not the primary diagnosis, and the symptoms can be explained by other conditions
SARS-CoV-2 infection is present, but it is not specific enough to be the primary diagnosis without additional symptoms
Viral retinitis is a possible diagnosis, but the presence of SARS-CoV-2 infection and optic neuritis symptoms makes R5 a more likely diagnosis
